tasks.short: Inspect passenger tickets and verify destination information

steps.what: Inspect the actual passenger ticket and read the flight, date and destination information
inputs: actual passenger-presented ticket or boarding document
outputs: attendant-read passenger ticket details and ambiguities

steps.what: Verify the ticket information and obtain destination context against the current authorised flight reference
inputs: attendant-read passenger ticket details and ambiguities
airline-owned current flight reference with flight id, operating date, destination and version
outputs: checked ticket-to-flight comparison and unresolved discrepancies

steps.what: Clarify any mismatch or destination question with the passenger and responsible airline colleague
inputs: checked ticket-to-flight comparison and unresolved discrepancies
actual passenger and colleague responses
outputs: attendant-understood destination information or unresolved issue for existing procedures

tasks.design: Configure a read-only current-flight reference in the {OPS_SYSTEM} so the attendant can compare ticket details without repeated navigation. The attendant still reads the actual ticket and resolves discrepancies with people; the view neither changes the booking nor records boarding automatically.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable flight reference can take time around a short physical ticket check.
tasks.enabler_now: Native flight-context views can keep date and destination together without interpreting a passenger's circumstances.
tasks.still_hard: Unreadable documents, changed flights and unclear questions need human clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when apparently matching details do not resolve the passenger's actual concern.

ambition.what: No new boarding or booking authority is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for authorised flight-reference access and cabin-use review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: airline operational views can provide current flight identifiers, dates and destinations for read-only comparison.

assumptions: Boundary is ticket inspection, verification and destination clarification. It does not include changing a booking, accepting payment or an assumed boarding-status write. If a carrier actually requires such a write here, split and measure it with its own final-version gate.

The passenger supplies the actual document; airline operations supplies current flight id, operating date, destination and reference version. s2 retains manual comparison and missing-reference handling; no automatic document extraction is assumed.

Native configuration first. No record, send, barcode scan or ticket validation commit is proposed. This scenario assumes reference navigation is part of current work; if the needed flight context is already known, the saving is zero.
Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Passenger interaction and existing system runtime earn no removed labour.
unknowns: Actual airline verification workflow and authorised device access
research_questions: Does a current-flight view reduce actual lookup without hiding date or flight mismatches?
Does the carrier require a separate status write during this task?

already_counted.description: Compare actual ticket details with the applicable flight reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 15 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 14.5. High allows 4.5 additional hours handling reference exceptions; low applies when no repeated lookup exists or the view is already configured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inventory headsets, alcoholic beverages and collected money

steps.what: Physically count actual headsets and alcoholic beverages in the assigned cabin inventory
inputs: actual assigned headsets and alcoholic beverage stock
outputs: actual item counts by stock identifier and condition

steps.what: Count the actual money collected and identify its currency and collection period
inputs: actual collected money and assigned collection period
outputs: actual counted money by currency and period

steps.what: Retrieve expected stock movements and recorded sales and payment totals for the same flight and period
inputs: catering-owner recorded stock issue and return references
existing cabin sales transactions and payment totals with flight and period
outputs: checked expected stock and collection totals

steps.what: Record actual headset, beverage and money counts with currency, condition and collection period
inputs: actual item counts by stock identifier and condition
actual counted money by currency and period
checked expected stock and collection totals
outputs: complete draft actual cabin inventory counts

steps.what: Compare actual counts and money with expected totals and record investigated or unresolved differences
inputs: complete draft actual cabin inventory counts
checked expected stock and collection totals
outputs: complete checked cabin inventory and variance record

steps.what: Check and approve the exact final actual inventory and collection record
inputs: complete checked cabin inventory and variance record

steps.what: Save the approved cabin inventory in the same operational inventory record
inputs: approved cabin inventory record v1
outputs: stored actual cabin inventory and collection record

tasks.design: Configure the {OPS_SYSTEM} flight inventory view and count form to reuse known item, flight and collection-period references and calculate differences. The attendant physically counts stock and money, enters actual values and investigates discrepancies before approving and saving the inventory.
tasks.previous_blocker: Expected totals, count-entry fields and variance arithmetic may require separate navigation despite existing sales records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native count forms and variance formulas can use explicit counts and existing transactions without inferring inventory from sales alone.
tasks.still_hard: Physical discrepancies, damaged items and mixed collection periods need human checking.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise that an apparent variance is a counting or period problem rather than silently balancing it away.

ambition.what: No additional cash-control authority or service is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-5 for stock and collection access and staff consultation if attribution changes

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operational inventory forms can compare manually captured counts with existing sales and stock records using fixed arithmetic.

assumptions: Boundary includes physical stock and collected-money counts, their actual capture and reconciliation record. Cash handover and restocking are separate work and earn no saving.

Catering owners already record stock issues; sale transactions are produced during normal sales. Required fields are flight id, period, item id, quantity and payment currency/amount. Missing or mismatched source totals are checked manually in s3/s5, not freely supplied by a new reporting task.
s4 retains 11.25 hours for every actual count and money-value entry and correction. Native configuration first; no connected cash counter or automatic physical stock measurement is assumed.

s5 reduction concerns arithmetic and known-reference checks; its four retained hours include discrepancy investigation. If exceptions take longer, the saving falls. No automatic balancing adjustment is permitted.
Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Same-system save remains fully retained; no hidden supervisor send or cash transfer is proposed.
unknowns: Current count form and expected-total access
research_questions: Can expected and counted values be matched to the same flight, period and currency?
Does the system keep unresolved variances visible?

already_counted.description: Enter and check actual inventory and money counts

incremental.description: Maintain item, period and currency mappings and variance checks

approvals.approved_version: approved cabin inventory record v1; edits require s6 again

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 17.25 minus 1 upkeep gives 16.25. High allows 4.25 additional hours investigating variances; low applies where expected totals and native count forms already cover the work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sell alcoholic beverages and complete the actual payment and receipt

steps.what: Discuss the passenger's alcoholic beverage request, available choices and stated price
inputs: actual passenger request
current authorised cabin beverage offer and price list
outputs: actual requested beverage and quantity understood by the attendant

steps.what: Apply the airline's service rules to the actual passenger situation and decide whether to proceed with the beverage sale
inputs: actual requested beverage and quantity understood by the attendant
actual passenger situation and existing authorised service rules
outputs: attendant decision to proceed or refuse service

steps.what: Select and physically serve the agreed alcoholic beverage to the passenger in the normal cabin-service exchange
inputs: attendant decision to proceed or refuse service
actual beverage stock and agreed passenger request
outputs: actual beverage served and sale item details

steps.what: Enter the actual beverage item and quantity in the cabin sales terminal and inspect its existing price calculation
inputs: actual beverage served and sale item details
existing authorised item codes, prices, currency and flight context
outputs: complete draft sale basket with item, quantity and amount

steps.what: Verify and authorise the exact sale basket and amount for collection from this passenger
inputs: complete draft sale basket with item, quantity and amount
actual passenger agreement

steps.what: Collect the authorised actual payment from the passenger using the existing supported payment method
inputs: approved passenger payment request v1
actual passenger payment
outputs: actual payment result and complete terminal-generated transaction and receipt preview

steps.what: Check actual payment status and approve the exact final transaction and receipt preview for this passenger
inputs: actual payment result and complete terminal-generated transaction and receipt preview
outputs: approved actual sale and receipt packet v2

steps.what: Finalise the approved actual beverage sale in the existing cabin sales record
inputs: approved actual sale and receipt packet v2

steps.what: Provide the exact approved receipt to the actual purchasing passenger
inputs: approved actual sale and receipt packet v2
committed actual beverage sale record

tasks.design: Configure native quick-selection keys for the current beverage offer in the {OPS_SYSTEM} cabin sales terminal. The attendant handles service judgement and physical delivery, enters actual quantities, verifies payment and separately finalises the sale and provides its approved receipt; existing price calculation and payment runtime create no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: A general item menu can require repeated navigation during a short cabin sale.
tasks.enabler_now: Native quick keys can reduce selection effort while retaining actual quantity entry and amount checks.
tasks.still_hard: Passenger service decisions, physical delivery and failed or unclear payment outcomes require the attendant.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when to refuse service and resolve a passenger concern respectfully.

ambition.what: No added service authority or sales programme is assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for terminal configuration and authorised offer review

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: point-of-sale systems can provide configured item quick keys while retaining actual quantity, payment and receipt checks.

assumptions: Boundary includes the actual sale, passenger interaction, serving, basket entry, payment, committed record and receipt. Payment is not excluded to make a conversation-only task; no passenger or system runtime is counted as removed focal labour.

Offer owners already maintain item id, price, currency and active status. The attendant creates actual item and quantity data in s4, retaining twelve hours for capture and checking. No inferred purchase, new price computation or free sales feed is assumed.

Native quick keys first. This is a provisional ordinary authorised sale scenario, not a description of any carrier's mandated sequence. Actual payment/service ordering must follow the carrier's existing procedure without claimed time reduction.

s5 approves an already complete basket before payment. The existing terminal supplies an actual result and full receipt preview in s6; s7 approves that final preview before the distinct internal finalisation and passenger receipt actions. Changed amount, recipient or payment result invalidates approval.

Shares and reductions are unmeasured scenarios, not historical baselines. Same-system finalisation and short receipt delivery remain fully retained; existing automatic price arithmetic and payment processing earn no saving.
unknowns: Actual terminal quick-key support and transaction lifecycle
Current supported payment and receipt methods
research_questions: Do quick keys reduce navigation without increasing wrong-item or quantity errors?
Does the actual terminal expose final payment status and receipt identity for the required checks?

already_counted.description: Capture actual sale items and check selected quantities and amount

approvals.approved_version: approved passenger payment request v1 with exact basket, amount and purchasing passenger; changes void approval
approved actual sale and receipt packet v2 including actual payment result; changes void approval
approved actual sale and receipt packet v2 with exact receipt and purchasing passenger; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 3 minus 0.5 upkeep gives 2.5. High allows one extra hour checking offer changes; low applies where item selection is already configured or quick keys yield no gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The attendant can spend less time navigating references and entering repeated fields while retaining passenger care, service judgement, actual counts and payment checks.
skills_to_grow: Check flight, period and currency references
Preserve actual count and payment status
role.ambitious_version: Make routine information and sales records easier to inspect while preserving the attendant's responsibility for the actual passenger and cabin situation.
